source_contracts.role: Stage settings numerical roles and independent controls
source_contracts.trace: StageSettings owns step count, GPU substeps, solver sweeps, metre-per-second-squared gravity, per-second damping, self collision switch, host-contact substep interval/iteration count and host body geometry switch. These differ despite u32/f32 storage. Validated steps0..600 intentionally permit zero, substeps1..32, iterations1..8, gravity0..30 finite, damping0..20 finite, host interval<=substeps, contact iterations1..8. Host interval0 disables host contacts; do not invent nonzero steps or require inactive settings disappear. Named settings are not arbitrary universal counts.

source_contracts.role: Actual apply receiver and policy payload distinction
source_contracts.trace: apply updates public SolverSettings.substeps/iterations/gravity/damping, SelfCollision.enabled, HostContactSchedule.interval_substeps/iterations with remaining default fields, and body surface geometry/clearance. Solver record_step/step_interleaved divides delta by substeps and iterates that count; record_substep loops iterations.max(1); record_predict passes numerical gravity/damping/substep to actual kernel parameter boundary. These are concrete lower numerical adapters, not blanket primitive exemptions. Self collision activation and host-body collision projection remain independent choices: GPU body collider remains active per declared policy, host_body_contacts chooses static host geometry or empty geometry. No >2-state policy established. Exact SelfCollision internal body is not available/claimed; receiving typed field boundary and Shell ownership suffice only to assess this producer assignment, not implementation correctness.

DrapeSettings groups sewing/settling settings but retains shared type for genuinely same validator/apply semantics. for_fabric initializes both coherently then changes settling gravity/damping; canonical Fabric damping is consumed. body_fit is finite fraction0..1 distinct from potentially>1 stretch ratio; preview_interval is nonzero simulation-step interval1..60 distinct from GPU substeps/contact sweeps. Actual selection.validate207-223 invokes drape.validate; drape run45 validates selection before simulation loops. No extra max/min bounds proposed.

source_contracts.role: Checkpoint historical payloads versus resume command
source_contracts.trace: DrapeCheckpoints retains input plus independent sewn/settled Options. DrapeStart::Placement, Settling{sewn}, Finish{sewn,settled} is a useful payload-owning resume decision. same_setup compares body/rig/skin/construction/fabric/resolution/obstacle geometry, sewing equality controls placement restart, settling equality controls settle rerun. Appearance/body_fit/underplate and human name are not automatically setup identity; existing finish-only consumers are preserved. Independent Options do not guarantee prefix: actual resumed settling producer creates settled-without-sewn (see observation). Distinguish history owner from transient resume command.

Existing tests exercise appearance/settling/sewing/body setup invalidation, unfinished checkpoints and interval validation with canonical PackedRigSkin native bound.
